def balanced(s):

    bracket in the right order. Text inside double-quoted strings is
    ignored; within a string a backslash escapes the next character.
    An unterminated string makes the input unbalanced."""
    stack = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        if ch == '"':
            # Skip the string body.
            i += 1
            closed = False

                c = s[i]
                if c == "\\":

                    continue
                if c == '"':

            if not closed:
                return False

            continue

            stack.append(ch)
        elif ch in PAIRS:
            if not stack or stack[-1] != PAIRS[ch]:
                return False
            stack.pop()

    return not stack
